admission.justification: A future preference refactor must not let one temporary passage action silently rewrite saved global presentation.

alternatives.option: Persist the general layout preference only; keep a passage Show inline override local to that passage.
alternatives.reason: The general preference is shared/saved, whereas the temporary override is for the passage on screen.

alternatives.option: Persist every passage override as if it were the global layout preference.
alternatives.reason: The general preference is shared/saved, whereas the temporary override is for the passage on screen.
alternatives.reconsider_when: An approved requirement introduces stable passage identity and explicitly asks for persistent per-passage overrides.

consequences: A future preference refactor must not let one temporary passage action silently rewrite saved global presentation.
The preference module owns global persistence; the passage renderer owns the transient override, and storage failures remain tolerated.
